meta.title: Detection & Correlation Workflow — PROPOSED DETERMINISTIC CORE

views.label: Validate and detect
views.note: Explicit validation and rules determine whether an event is suspicious.

views.label: Correlate and act
views.note: Time/entity/process/IOC evidence drives the create-or-update decision.

views.label: Benign path
views.note: A non-suspicious event is stored without creating an alert or incident.

cards.title: Receive + Validate
items: What: accept a RawEvent and reject malformed input; Input: fixture event; Output: accepted/rejected event.
Knowledge used: Event vs Alert vs Incident, log families, required security fields.
Learn before: read basic auth/process/network events; Later — Future Extension: streaming ingestion; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Normalize
items: What: preserve source facts in common semantics; Input: valid RawEvent; Output: NormalizedEvent.
Knowledge used: user/host/IP/process/domain, process tree, network direction, timestamps.
Learn before: field semantics; Later — Future Extension: ECS/OCSF; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Run Rules + Suspicious Gate
items: What: apply explicit thresholds/behavior logic; Input: NormalizedEvent; Output: Detection or no alert.
Knowledge used: detection engineering, IOC vs behavior, FP/FN, brute force, contextual PowerShell.
Learn before: tune golden and benign scenarios; Later — Future Extension: Sigma/ML; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Find Related + Correlation Score
items: What: retrieve nearby evidence and score shared user/host/IP/process/time/IOC links; Input: Detection + events; Output: scored related group.
Knowledge used: temporal reasoning, entity/process relationships, evidence.
Learn before: justify each score contribution; Later — Future Extension: graph/probabilistic correlation; Depth: Intermediate.

cards.title: Existing Incident Gate
items: What: choose update or create; Input: correlated group; Output: incident action.
Knowledge used: Alert vs Incident, lifecycle, evidence traceability, severity vs confidence.
Learn before: explain when multiple alerts form one case; Later — Future Extension: formal triage queues; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Update/Create → MITRE → Investigation
items: What: persist evidence, apply deterministic evidence-to-technique mapping, then trigger investigation support; Input: incident action; Output: updated/new incident ready for retrieval and copilot.
Knowledge used: incident timeline; tactic/technique/sub-technique/TTP; evidence-backed mapping.
Learn before: map T1110/T1059.001 without an LLM; Later — Future Extension: broader ATT&CK coverage; Depth: Basic.

cards.title: Hard Boundary
items: No LLM decides Suspicious?, correlation score, incident membership, or ATT&CK mapping
RAG/LLM begins only after deterministic incident facts exist
Every unimplemented node is Proposed; advanced capabilities are Future Extension
